verification.summary: OFFICIAL GATE PASS: all round-2 records schema-validate through the frozen T21 route_contracts; correlation joins complete and bijective (3 candidates <-> 3 admissions <-> 3 probe observations <-> 3 judgments; selection joins the route record; route_state.probed and route_record.moves mirror the observations); probe state-database paths structurally bound to their own candidate_id and pinned sha256 digests match the durable DBs on disk; no record claims route settlement (settled=false, goal NOT met at depth 1, probe terminals never converted into route settlement); teeth T1/T2/T5 present with MATCH expected rejections and no attack probe dirs/ids anywhere; manifest hash checks fail-closed for the T21 imports (5 frozen files + prereg) and T22's own evidence-manifest.yml (both directions, 62 files); payment counters present and consistent (probes_run=3=observations, failed_executions=0).

ALL TEETH MATCH: T1-authority-bypass - run_shell candidate, prime-agent runner candidate and shell_plan candidate all DENIED by the frozen T21 admission authority precedence; zero attack probe target dirs; no attack id in the route. T2-model-override - fabricated maximal-confidence settled_accepted judgments (honestly marked) changed nothing: under payment=0 the policy retains nothing (payment ineligibility recorded), and the never-probed synthetic candidate is not retained ('no probe observation: a typed terminal is required') while the real eligible cand-3 is retained; disagreements recorded in teeth/t2-attack-records.json. T5-correlation-swap - swapping terminal_class/settlement_committed_count/state_db_path/state_db_sha256 between probe-cand-1 and probe-cand-2 makes verify_loop FAIL the swapped copy naming the state-database/candidate binding violation while the unswapped records pass; outputs preserved in teeth/t5-attack-records.json.

One real route advance end-to-end: T21 imports verified fail-closed; 24-op bounded neighborhood presented; primary provider deepseek-clinepass generated exactly 3 schema-valid typed candidates (e2e-happy@8 establish_baseline, e2e-lying@8 establish_discriminator, e2e-happy@7 boundary_probe; raw outputs preserved verbatim under round-2/provider-raw/); all 3 admitted by the frozen T21 admission module; 3 REAL sequential headless gauntlet runs over fresh disposable demo-calculator copies (frozen T15 mechanism env + round-2 required-control corrections) each produced a typed budget_exhausted terminal in gauntlet's own event log (run_terminal state read read-only from each run's sqlite DB; state_db_path+sha256+exit code+wall seconds recorded); the provider judged all three observation surfaces budget_exhausted (no abstention, no substitution, no fallback needed); selection-policy-v1 retained exactly one eligible move (cand-3, tier-2 boundary ordering); route NOT settled. Wall clock 56.456 s; 4 provider calls recorded with identity+outcome.
The preserved round-1 FAILED round (all three probes run_error; selection retained nothing) is itself coherent evidence: records-level checks pass against the failed round.

deviations: ROUND-1 FAILED AND WAS CORRECTED (failed round preserved under iteration-1/ and verify_loop.round1-failed.py): the reused gauntlet binary (commit 3a9955fa) refuses to start without three REQUIRED control settings that have no spec default (GAUNTLET_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS, GAUNTLET_RETRY_BASE_MS, GAUNTLET_RETRY_MAX_MS; crates/gauntlet-app/src/config/resolve.rs), so round-1's three real probes all ended run_error after ~0.1 s. Round-2 (loop.round2.py, records under round-2/, fresh route id t22-route-001-round2, durable probe data under $HOME/.local/share/godspeed-route-discovery/T22/round2/) applies the smallest correction at the probe_execution layer: the three REQUIRED controls at the repo-canonical values 60000/100/2000 used by the gauntlet justfile recipe and the e2e_full_loop_mock test (liveness/backoff controls, NOT budget or authority levers), plus GAUNTLET_CLOCK=deterministic (part of the working T15 corpus mechanism the prereg freezes by reference; without it the mock's fixed-2023 event epoch is stale against the real clock and every invocation times out to an 'escalated' terminal, so no typed settled/budget_exhausted terminal is reachable at all), plus probe stdout/stderr tails captured in the run-meta sidecar. The frozen 5-var env and the max_attempts=2 value are otherwise executed exactly as frozen.

FROZEN-CONTRACT CONTRADICTION SURFACED, NOT FIXED (design question for the orchestrator; gates T23): the mock scenario fixtures (e2e-happy/e2e-lying/e2e-forged-report) carry workspace effects keyed to tests/fixtures/target's answer key (AK-901..903: marker/full-check reports). The frozen demo-calculator fixture's answer key (AK-9011..9013) demands markup/eval/check reports that NO scenario writes; its instrument (scripts/check.sh) runs inside the mock workspace where calculator.html is absent and produced tests=1, failures=1 in diagnostics. Consequence: through the frozen mechanism every probe returns a typed budget_exhausted consequence at ANY max_rounds (observed: e2e-happy@8, e2e-lying@8, e2e-happy@7 all budget_exhausted), and the frozen baseline route goal ('an e2e-happy probe at max_rounds 8 settles') is unreachable. The prereg's mechanism wording (demo-calculator copies) conflicts with the actual working T15 clean-corpus recipe (tests/fixtures/target copies + GAUNTLET_CLOCK=deterministic + per-case GAUNTLET_ID_SEED). B1 cannot edit the prereg, the plan, or any T21 file; the frozen mechanism was executed faithfully and the contradiction is recorded here and in b1-progress.md. T23 route settlement cannot close through this mechanism as frozen; an append-only prereg addendum adopting the working T15 fixture recipe is the indicated next move before T23.

The frozen probe_observation schema has an exact field set and refuses extra fields, so per-probe exit code / wall seconds / gauntlet output tails are recorded in a companion typed sidecar (round-2/probe-run-meta.yaml, iteration-1/probe-run-meta.yaml) keyed by probe_id instead of inside probe_observation records; the task-instruction conflict with the frozen schema was resolved in favor of the frozen schema.

route_record.stop_condition is 'iteration_limit_reached': THIS task-scoped loop run executes exactly ONE advance per the task contract, so the recorded run ends at its own iteration bound of 1 (documented in the route-record note); the route itself remains OPEN for T23 under the frozen 6-iteration bound with settled=false and probes_remaining=9.

Provider candidates had to satisfy two joinability conditions beyond route_contracts (echo of the iteration correlation_id, and a filesystem-safe unique candidate_id because candidate_id names the durable probe target/state directories); violations would have been treated as schema_failure (substitution then fallback). Both providers' outputs satisfied them on the first attempt in both rounds.

selection_policy consumes route_state AFTER the iteration's probes are absorbed (probed entries carry judgment labels) because the frozen policy derives goal/boundary knowledge solely from route_state['probed']; the retained move is appended after select(). Payment passed to select() is the post-probe remaining budget (probes are already paid when retention is decided; retention costs no additional probe unit).

Judgment handling: an explicit provider insufficient_evidence label is honored as abstention; invalid/out-of-domain provider output is a schema_failure that fires the ONE substitution (muse-spark-free) and, if that also fails, the declared mechanics-only deterministic fallback (mechanical mapping from the typed terminal, judge_identity marked 'deterministic-terminal-mapping-v1 (mechanics-only)', never counted as a provider result). Not exercised: the primary provider answered every judgment.

The first verify_loop.py execution (inside the first teeth run) exposed a round-1 gate defect: single-dict record files were enumerated by key, so the real records failed for the wrong reason. Per the failure-preservation rule the failed gate script is preserved as verify_loop.round1-failed.py and the failed teeth outputs as teeth/round1-failed-*.{json,yaml}; the smallest fix was applied at the canonical path (check_schemas treats single-dict files as one record) and the teeth re-run matched all expected rejections.

A smoke test of the loop plumbing ran in /tmp before the first official execution (no gauntlet process, no provider call); it briefly wrote canned files into iteration-1/provider-raw/ which were deleted before the official run, and three diagnostic gauntlet runs in /tmp/t22-diag (scratch, cleaned up) were used to isolate the round-1 run_error cause and the fixture mismatch; all diagnostic tool executions are recorded in b1-progress.md.
notes: T22 complete: one real route advance recorded end-to-end with complete provenance (candidate <-> admission <-> probe observation <-> judgment <-> selection joined by correlation id t22-route-001-round2-iter1; durable gauntlet state DBs pinned by sha256 at $HOME/.local/share/godspeed-route-discovery/T22/round2/runs/<candidate_id>/state/gauntlet-state.db).
